description_en: Creates a diagnostic report for a specified resource
kebab_example: aliyun ebs create-diagnose-report --diagnose-type Performance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDiagnoseReport

parameters.help_en:
The diagnosis type. The only valid value is:

Performance: performance diagnosis
parameters.help_zh:
诊断类型，可选的有：

Performance：性能诊断
parameters.name: diagnose_type

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. The only valid value is:

Disk: a cloud disk
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。当前可选的有：

Disk
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The start time for the diagnosis, in UTC. The time must be in the ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ)
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for the diagnosis, in UTC. The time must be in the ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ)
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call the DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/developer-reference/api-ebs-2021-07-30-describeregions?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i7) operation to find all regions supported by EBS Data Insight
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/developer-reference/api-ebs-2021-07-30-describeregions?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i7)查询块存储数据洞察支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotency. This lets you safely retry the request without creating a duplicate diagnostic report. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 服务端生成的一串字符串，作为客户端进行请求的一个标识
parameters.name: client_token

ReportId.description_zh: 诊断报告ID，资源诊断报告的唯一标志
